description: Do not let Renovate float the Go toolchain inside .github/workflows/go-ci.yml.

Why: the staticcheck job runs dominikh/staticcheck-action with install-go: false and GOTOOLCHAIN=local, so staticcheck is BUILT and RUN with exactly the toolchain actions/setup-go installs there. That version is bounded on both sides: staticcheck's own go.mod sets a minimum (2026.2 declares `go 1.26.0`), and a staticcheck release can only decode export data from the toolchains it shipped with, so a newer toolchain fails every stdlib import.

Renovate does not manage that action's `version:` input — only actions/setup-{go,node,python} inputs and a fixed community-action registry are extracted — so the toolchain would float while the linter pin stayed frozen, breaking the job on every Go minor release.
History: commits 33db5b2 and f7f90cd each rewrote a deliberate `go-version: "1.25.x"` pin in that job, leaving behind a comment that then described the opposite of the config.

Deriving the version from go/go.mod does NOT work: the module floor (go 1.25.0) is below staticcheck 2026.2's minimum, so the build fails outright. The module floor and the linter toolchain are different things.
To move the Go toolchain used for linting, edit the `go-version:` pin in that job and review the staticcheck `version:` pin in the same change.
Scope: matchDepTypes uses-with covers only setup-* version inputs, so `uses:` action digest updates in this file keep flowing normally.
